name: Cell rinse, dissociation, quench, wash and encapsulation chip
description: Rinses and detaches the cells, quenches the enzyme, washes the cells in a spiral, mixes in core solution and forms ~70 um droplets at the flow-focusing junction. Parametric parts: modules culture_1, quench_join, quench_mix, cell_wash, core_join, core_mix use the nearest library block as a stand-in (real part and sizing in autochip_part / params). build_chip.py builds the stand-ins at library size; the exact chip needs the autochip layout stage.
source: autochip chip plan spc_capsule_workflow_resin_print_multilayer (protocol spc_capsule_workflow, constraints resin_print_multilayer)

modules.does: Holds the cells while buffer rinses them and then the dissociation enzyme detaches them. Both are water-based, so one shared reagent_line is used and the syringe is swapped between steps.
Quench medium joins the cell stream to stop the enzyme.
Mixes the quench medium into the cell stream gently.
Moves the cells into clean wash buffer, replacing the centrifuge pellet and the two resuspension washes (run twice).
Core solution joins the washed cell stream so the cells are suspended for encapsulation.
Mixes the cells into the core solution just before the junction.
The cell/core stream arrives on the main line, warm shell polymer and fluorinated oil enter through their own inlets, and ~70 um droplets pinch off.

off_chip.why: Three-day culture of adherent cells in a CO2 incubator is done in a vessel at the bench.
Cell counting and viability check are done on the bench.

missing_parts.need: Pillar filter with ~30 um gap for cells (0.75 x the 40 um nozzle)
missing_parts.why: The pillar filter cannot go below 100 um gap, and a 100 um gap would not protect the 40 um nozzle from clumps.

steps_text.2: Remove the medium and rinse the cells once with buffer.
steps_text.3: Add dissociation enzyme and incubate to detach the cells.
steps_text.4: Add quench medium and mix gently to stop the enzyme.
steps_text.5: Centrifuge the cells and remove the supernatant.
steps_text.6: Resuspend the pellet in wash buffer to wash the cells; repeat the wash once.
steps_text.9: Resuspend the cells in core solution at the loading density.
steps_text.10: Co-flow the cell/core solution with warm shell polymer solution and focus with fluorinated oil with surfactant at a flow-focusing junction to form droplets of about 70 um.
